summary.text: Jesse Huseth is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 97, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jesse Huseth was the Democratic candidate for District 97 in 2024, when he received 48.3% of the vote in the general election against Republican incumbent John Gillespie.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for the seat on August 6, 2026.
